messages.subject: Any reset for actionButton? (need updateActionButton)
parts:
I would like to have press of an actionButton trigger a conditionalPanel, and then after stuff is done in the conditional Panel, I would like to reset the actionButton value to zero so that the conditionalPanel disappears.  I could do this with a function like updateActionButton, but this function does not exist.

Any alternative suggestions?

messages.author: 8e72bac5f7bfb16e
messages.subject: Re: Any reset for actionButton? (need updateActionButton)
parts:
well...  in case it might help anyone:

I created a work-around, using a checkboxInput() as a surrogate for an action button.  Its values are updatable with updateCheckboxInput().
